rawFinal: Accepted only for original CargoGuard focused tests. Reviewed actual nine authored source paths and sixteen new tests. Whole batch planning validates template carriers and real grid capacity on a cloned inventory; UID0 stays a private placeholder until complete planning, all new roots are assigned before publication, and partial mint failure burns IDs without partial inventory delivery. Nonempty shadow/fenced grants reject even merge-only requests. Quest item rewards and carry items prepare before completion/currency/task consumption; trusted synthetic equipment issuance is completed before any live quest publication, with exact assigned UID retained by replace_equipment. Mining authority failure leaves stones/pickaxe/inventory unchanged. Fishing failure cancels autocast before success/spawn/reel wear, while preserving the existing chance-counter increment. Legacy issuance uses the prior local allocator and inventory whole-item custody remains unchanged. Static review found no confirmed P0/P1 or compilation blocker. This is not an assertion that tests passed, nor durable atomic account publication or normal gateway/NPC/UI acceptance.
limits: Only controlled File opt-in paths; public catalog and normal gateway remain disabled.
Remaining generic grants/normalization, fresh world drops, script/GM, mail, full-server census and PostgreSQL issuance remain outstanding.
Focused and adjacent tests must run through the unchanged original Guard; no test pass claimed by this source review.
New fault-message translations and frontend behavior are not accepted in this round.
